mapper.select: SELECT fnd06_office_work_id AS office_work_id, fnd06_office_work_nm AS office_work_name, fnd06_office_work_cd AS office_work_code, fnd06_kofia_cd AS kofia_code, fnd06_etc_office_work_cd01 AS etc_office_work_code01, fnd06_office_work_use_yn AS use_yn, fnd06_office_work_note AS note, fnd06_company_id AS company_id FROM fnd06_office_work WHERE fnd06_company_id = 0 AND fnd06_company_id = #{companyId} AND ( ( #{useYn} = 'true' AND COALESCE(fnd06_office_work_use_yn,'true') = 'true' ) OR ( #{useYn} = 'false' ) ) AND fnd06_office_work_cd||fnd06_office_work_nm LIKE '%'||#{searchText}||'%' ORDER BY fnd06_office_work_cd
